This appears to be a typo that accidentally passes the test by breaking the logic in a way that masks the real issue. The patch does not fix the underlying ordering problem shown in the test failure.

This appears to be a typo that happens to pass the test by accident rather than fixing the underlying bug. The actual issue is likely in the ordering of namespace initialization, not in finding the dot position.
